engine_type: Native Ubuntu Docker; existing enrolled engine, separate from Docker Desktop.
boot_task_principal_mode: S4U, Limited; final launch observed in session 0
boot_task_change_scope: Action only; original principal, trigger, settings and DACL preserved.
sign_in_helper: Bounded health observer; task Running is not a health verdict.
foreground_keeper: Singleton flock; retains WSL lifetime and checks continuous root recovery supervisor.
dependency_order: verified existing cluster containers and networking
identity_guards: Enrolled engine, existing container, cluster and node identities
Expected storage mappings and PVC/PV identities
Exact current API endpoint /32 after identity validation
supervision: Repeated dependency checks with backoff; starts inactive dependencies only; running workloads are not restarted by health probes.
runner_policy: Restart=always; 10-to-60-second systemd backoff; no permanent start-rate lockout.
runner_update_boundary: Root-owned supervisor and final systemd drop-in are outside mutable runner application/base-unit files; supervisor loads current installed Runner.
health_acceptance: Successful authenticated control-plane response; current boot, matching MainPID, accepted age <=45 seconds; node/API/workload/storage checks, fresh supervisor and held WSL keeper lock.
